Delhi Metro Achieves 99.95% Punctuality in 2026

Delhi Metro recorded 99.95% train punctuality in the year 2026. This achievement places it among the top five transit systems globally. The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) has seen significant growth since its establishment in 2002. The punctuality rate reportedly surpasses that of transit systems in Hong Kong, Paris, and New York.
